subject: music
title: Hip-Hop & Electronic
welcome_lead: Beats, samples and the music made on computers.
meta_desc: KS3 genres: hip-hop and electronic music.
final_note: Two genres built on technology rather than orchestras.

concepts.def: Genre of rap over sampled beats.
Bit of recorded sound reused in a new song.
Record player used by DJs to scratch.

walkthroughs.body_html: Hip-hop began in 1970s New York. DJs used two turntables to extend the breakbeats; MCs rapped over the top. The four elements: DJing, rapping, breakdancing and graffiti.
A sample is a snippet of an existing recording reused in a new track. Hip-hop producers built whole songs from drum samples of older funk and soul records.
Electronic music uses synthesisers and computers (DAWs like GarageBand or Ableton) rather than traditional instruments. House, techno and dubstep are all electronic genres.
